_derivation: AUTHORITATIVE ADJACENCY IS DERIVED, NOT THIS FILE (ADR 0022). The produced_by/triggers lists below are a human-readable, frozen SEED SUBSET. At catalog load, derive_card_events(SEED_MAP) replaces every non-empty-seed side with the sorted descendant-closure of that side's SEED_MAP seeds (derive_card_events.py); only empty-seed sides (game-end, library-depleted raw lists) pass through from this file. So these lists may lag the derived view (e.g. land-enters shows `ramp` but the derived view uses the `land-ramp` closure; game-end shows [] but the derived view carries alternate-win-condition/lose-trigger from SEED_MAP). To see the real adjacency, read SEED_MAP in derive_card_events.py. Some refs match zero live cards in the lake (sac, clones, tokens, combat, counters, artifacts) but are RETAINED: sac/clones await a seed rename in a later wave; tokens/combat/counters/artifacts are carried as shorthand otags by the hermetic parity fixtures, so deleting them shifts the held engine/resolve parity SHAs and is NOT output-inert (the audit's §8 lake-only inert estimate does not account for the fixtures). Their removal is deferred to a fixture-aware re-baseline.

land-enters-battlefield.rule: CR 305: a land entering the battlefield (play/fetch/extra land drop)

creature-enters-battlefield.rule: CR 603.6: ETB triggered abilities; tokens/reanimation/flicker put creatures onto the battlefield. Uses `repeatable-creature-tokens` (not the `repeatable-token-generator` umbrella — its non-creature-token children make no creature ETB) (#74 R2 §3.4 coupled fix)

permanent-leaves-battlefield.rule: CR 603.6c: leaves-the-battlefield triggers; flicker/blink and bounce cause leaves events

permanent-dies.rule: CR 700.4: a creature/permanent going to the graveyard from the battlefield (dies). The removal producer is the SUBTRACTIVE synth attribute `dies-removal` (otag:removal minus removal-exile/-bounce/-tuck) — zone-changes to exile/hand/library are NOT deaths and dodge death triggers; the holistic `removal` otag stays in permanent-leaves-battlefield (#74 R2 §3.1)

permanent-sacrificed.rule: CR 701.17: sacrifice as a cost/effect; a sacrifice is also a death event

card-enters-graveyard.rule: CR 404: graveyard zone; mill/discard/death/sacrifice fill the graveyard

spell-cast.rule: CR 601: casting a spell; noncreature/instant-sorcery casts drive magecraft/spellslinger/storm. impulse-cast (exile-and-you-may-cast) is a real CR 601.1b producer. COPY CAVEAT: copies are NOT cast (CR 707.12), so copy-* producers over-promise for cast-only payoffs (storm/prowess/cast-trigger) — but magecraft (CR 702.157a) counts 'casts or copies' and is in the trigger closure, so the copy->cast-trigger edge is precise for magecraft and a deliberate over-promise elsewhere.

creature-attacks.rule: CR 508: declare attackers; attack-trigger payoffs and go-wide

combat-damage-dealt.rule: CR 510: combat damage; double-strike/evasion convert attacks to damage

life-loss-drain.rule: CR 119.3 (life loss) / CR 120.3 (only damage to a PLAYER causes life loss): drain and symmetric life-loss payoffs (aristocrats). Producers are the player-facing damage/drain slice ONLY — burn to creatures/battles/planeswalkers (removal-burn, burn-battle, bombard, burn-creature) is NOT life loss and the `burn` umbrella was dropped (#74 R2 §3.2)

counter-placed.rule: CR 122: counters; +1/+1 and other counters placed on permanents

proliferate.rule: CR 701.27: proliferate adds another of each kind of counter

token-created.rule: CR 111 / 701.6: creating token permanents (creatures, Treasure, Food, Clue)

artifact-enters.rule: CR 603.6 / CR 603.6a: artifact ETB on a zone change (a permanent ENTERING); Treasure/Clue/Food and artifact tokens. A permanent that merely BECOMES an artifact (artifactify) or is animated into a creature (animate-artifact) does NOT re-enter, so fires no ETB — both dropped (#74 R2 §3.4)

food-created.rule: CR 701.6: Food token creation and consumption (eat Food to gain life); Food is defined at CR 111.10

recursion-from-graveyard.rule: CR 404 + reanimation/regrowth: returning cards from the graveyard

deathtouch-combat.rule: CR 702.2: deathtouch; any damage is lethal — a combat/removal pseudo-event

extra-turn.rule: CR 500.7 / CR 720 (Taking an Extra Turn): an extra turn is created and taken after this one; infinite turns = effective win (policy). Split from the former monarch-or-extra-turn (#74 §2).

monarch.rule: CR 726 (The Monarch): a player becomes the monarch (draw at end step; designation moves on combat damage / monarch leaving). #74 §2.2 option ii (FUNCTIONAL SPLIT): Scryfall carries one monarch-matters tag on both makers and payoffs, so a single attr on both sides formed no edge (the p != c_ self-pair exclusion). The monarch-maker synth attr (oracle:'become the monarch', 62 makers) now isolates the PRODUCER side, so maker -> payoff edges form.

creature-copied.rule: CR 707 / 701.6: a token or permanent that is a COPY of a creature is minted under your control (clone, steal-via-copy of a dying creature, populate-of-a-creature-token). Producers are the copy-creature/clone identity (the `clones` bucket) plus the token-copy families (copy-token/copy-self = populate); the EVENT covers token-copy even though the clones ARCHETYPE does not. A minted copy is a new creature/token permanent, so it is consumed by the creature-/token-enters payoffs (and, when the copy is also a Food as with Shelob, by the Food/lifegain payoffs).

untap.rule: CR 701.21: untap a permanent. Untap effects re-arm tapped abilities and attackers (the madness/activated-ability reuse loop, e.g. Anje untapping herself). Producers are the untapper families; consumers are the untapped-matters payoffs. NOTE: the Anje-style reuse loop closes through the card's own ACTIVATED ABILITY, a relation the otag catalog does not express as an untap consumer, so the untap edge isolates only on decks carrying an explicit untapped-matters payoff.

player-counter.rule: CR 122 + Fallout rad / CR 122.1a energy: a counter placed on a PLAYER (rad + energy counters). Rad counters have NO Scryfall otag, so the producer `rad-counter` is an oracle-text synth attribute; energy counters ARE player counters (CR 122.1a) with a real producer `energy-generator` (137) and consumer `counter-fuel-energy` (122), moved here from counter-placed (#74 §4.4) where no energy producer sat. Rad counters fuel self-mill (and feed proliferate); energy fuels its payoffs.

mana-produced.rule: CR 106: producing mana (tapping lands, mana dorks, rituals, Treasure sacrifice). Covers 179 Spellbook mana fids (13.3% of features, 34% of corpus combos had no event home before this). Classified by feature name, not by the uncountable+mana derivation (see ADR 0007 when wired).

game-end.rule: CR 104.1/104.2/104.3: the game ends. Terminal node — the walk target. Fids map here with polarity (win/draw/loss) from the research route and scope from the feature. Rule-edges from life-loss-drain (SBA 104.3b), library-depleted (CR 104.3c), and combat-damage-dealt reach game-end through the EventEffect graph.

library-depleted.rule: CR 104.3c: a player with an empty library who would draw loses. Covers mill/library-exile fids directed at opponents (32 features). Replaces the implicit 'deckout' concept with an explicit event node; a rule-edge to game-end (CR 104.3c) will be wired in the EventEffect graph when the adapter is consumed.

poisoned.rule: CR 104.3d / 704.5c: a player with ten or more poison counters loses the game (SBA). Poison counters are PLAYER counters; producers are the mechanic-exclusive poison GIVER otags (poisonous, poison-opponents, gives-infect/toxic/poisonous; 163 cards, all prec 1.0 vs the poison family) — the parent poison-mechanics (198) is excluded because its closure also carries the consumer synergy-poison and removes-infect/gains-* cards. The payoff/consumer is synergy-poison (42). The poisoned -> game-end WIN rule-edge lives in combo_win.py (EVENT_EDGE_CLASSES['poisoned'] = ['altwin::poisoned']); it is walk-inert until a poison fid route exists (fid 1800 -> None today).

domain.rule: CR 104.2a: an effect states that a player wins the game (Coalition Victory: control a land of each basic land type and a creature of each color -> you win). The reusable board-state is a STATE-EVENT `domain` (ADR 0024): enablers PRODUCE the five-color/all-basic-type state, the wincon CONSUMES it. produced_by = the authored SYNTH attr `color-fixing` (union oracle:'mana of any color' OR otag:rainbow-land, 709 fixers; no clean otag exists and the evaluator must not grow a produced_mana atom, ADR 0009 — KNOWN GAP: basic-land-TYPE fixers are not covered). triggers = the authored SYNTH attr `five-color-win` (otag:alternate-win-condition AND oracle:'each color' = Coalition Victory + Call the Spirit Dragons). The domain -> game-end WIN rule-edge lives in combo_win.py (EVENT_EDGE_CLASSES['domain'] = ['altwin::domain']); walk-inert until a domain fid route exists (none today, mirrors poisoned). life-threshold was DROPPED this wave — the existing `lifegain` event already models the lifegain-win (altwin::lifegain = Felidar/Angel/Test); a second event would double-count.
